name: Zoom
description:
Zoom is one of the most popular video-conferencing platforms and with its user-friendly, accessible interface, it is a good choice for your online classes.
Some popular features of Zoom are its Whiteboard, Breakout Rooms, and screen-sharing features.
Anyone can access a Zoom meeting through a link that the organizer sends to their email.

name: Google Meet
description:
The Google suite of products contains Google Meet, a wonderful video chatting technology, which integrates well with other tools like Google Jamboard and Google Slides.
Google Meet also allows screen-sharing and includes Breakout Rooms in the paid version.
You and all of your users must have a gmail account to use this tool and the corresponding suite of useful cloud software that Google has.

name: Microsoft Teams
description:
This is a popular video chat and online work platform which many people use for education today.
Teams offers a variety of features and seeks to be an end to end solution for working and learning online.
However, we feel that many of its features are not intuitive. We include it here since it is enormously popular and offers many interesting features, such as the ability to collaborate on a PowerPoint or Word document. For that reason, you should be aware of it.
